question: Can I Upload My Own Custom SVG Icons to Use in Elementor?
metaDescription: Yes — upload an SVG icon set as a zip through Elementor Pro's Custom Icons feature, and it becomes selectable alongside the built-in icon library.
shortAnswer: Elementor Pro's Custom Icons feature accepts a properly formatted zip file of SVG icons, adding them as a selectable icon set alongside the built-in library across every widget with an icon control, once uploaded and the file structure is correctly prepared according to Elementor's specific format requirements.

bodyHtml:
How Custom Icon Upload Works

Elementor requires custom icons to follow a specific package format (generated by a tool like IcoMoon or Fontello, exported in the correct structure) rather than accepting individual raw SVG files directly for this specific feature — the zip needs particular files inside it (an icon font, a style sheet, metadata) for Elementor to correctly register the set as a usable icon library.

Why Custom Icons Are Useful

  • Brand-specific iconography not available in the standard built-in library, keeping visual consistency with an established brand identity.
  • A more focused, curated icon set, avoiding the need to browse a huge generic library for icons that will actually be used.
  • Individual SVG images (not through this specific Custom Icons feature) can also be used directly via a regular Image widget, an option worth considering for a single specific icon rather than uploading a whole set.
  • SVG security considerations apply here too, since SVG files can contain embedded scripts — only upload icon sets from a trusted source.

Uploading a Custom Icon Set

  1. Prepare the icon set in Elementor's required package format using a tool like IcoMoon.
  2. Upload the zip file through Elementor → Custom Icons.
  3. Select icons from the new set anywhere an icon control appears across widgets.

Need a custom icon library or branded widget set built properly? See Elementor custom widgets.
